messages:
maya (VP People): follow-up from today’s all-hands about hiring + org changes. dropping the plan here and a quick Q&A.

sam (CTO): short version: 28 new roles for FY. Q2 focused on runtime + infra to hit latency goals.

lisa (People Ops): Q2 hiring burst = ~20 prioritized reqs; templates + rubrics will be posted in #recruiting in 1h.

jordan (eng-manager): which teams get the Q2 burst? need to schedule interview panels.

maya (VP People): Q2 targets: eng-runtime 10, eng-infra/eng-sre 6, devex/docs 4. 4 flexible reserves.

nina (IC): any involuntary cuts tied to this?

maya (VP People): no layoffs. mainly reporting-line consolidation to reduce duplicated projects.

sam (CTO): oncall unchanged short-term; new hires will shadow. if pager metrics don’t improve we’ll add SRE hires.

lisa (People Ops): target time req->offer = 6-8w senior, 4-6w mid/junior. read-only tracker (no PII) will be shared tomorrow.

maya (VP People): next steps: Lisa posts reqs/rubrics; Sam and I hosting 30m manager Q&A Friday 10:00. DM for sensitive issues.

harper (allhands-bot): :calendar: Event created: "Hiring sprint managers Q&A" Fri 10:00 1 maya, sam, lisa.

maya (VP People): thanks all 1 we’ll publish a before/after team map and suggested manager talking points by EOD Thursday.
